long_biography.plain_text:
Russian-language training and a year as a United Nations officer in Bosnia gave Kristoffer Melinder an unusual start before finance. He studied economics in Stockholm and Cologne, then entered JP Morgan's leveraged-finance and advisory group in London. In 1998 he moved to Nordic Capital, where healthcare deals became an early specialism.

Melinder's approach has centred on active ownership rather than passive capital. He has worked with management teams on acquisitions, operational improvement and international expansion, while also advising investments in financial services and consumer businesses. The partnership promoted him to co-managing partner and made him its sole leader in 2016. He now guides investment decisions across a larger international platform, combining deal selection with the patient work of strengthening portfolio companies.
